slice: Oyatie Cloud tenant workload plane polish
intent: Make Oyatie Cloud visibly host FD-001 microservices as dogfood tenant workloads and route those hosted workloads back into Workflow, Mail, Community, Evidence, and deployment gates without wiring production side effects.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Replaced the Cloud Ops workload table with a visible FD-001 Tenant Workload Plane that names Workflow, built-in Comms, Evidence, and Identity as tenant workloads on Oyatie Cloud cells.
Added selectable workload cards with service, cell, route, receipt, and state metadata so the cloud substrate proof reads as an operational cockpit rather than a generic cloud widget.
Added local workload routes to Workflow, Mail brief, Community, Evidence, and Deployment Gates; Mail/Community routes insert local drafts through the existing Work Hub handoff bus.
Synchronized workload selection with cockpit status, Product Activity Spine, command shell status, activity feed, and detail receipts while preserving no backend/deploy/cloud mutation.
Added responsive CSS for the tenant workload plane using existing Bominal/dense command-surface tokens and verified desktop/tablet/mobile no-overflow behavior.

before_metrics.issue: Oyatie Cloud already showed topology and generic services, but FD-001 microservices did not feel explicitly hosted as tenant workloads with direct product-surface routes.

visual_ralph_verdict.category_match: Hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate command surface integrated with FD-001 product workload graph
differences: The reference Bominal interface is a standalone local app; Oyatie intentionally keeps global shell rail, Product Activity Spine, and cloud/product proof copy visible.
Cloud workload actions are local visual routes, not provider operations, by product requirement.
suggestions: Next slices can make Finance/Identity/Intelligence emit the same workload receipts into the cloud plane.
A future persistent mock state store could retain workload selection across reloads once the prototype moves beyond visual-only state.
visual_ralph_verdict.reasoning: The new plane makes the user's substrate thesis explicit: FD-001 microservices are shown as tenant workloads on Oyatie Cloud, selectable, routeable, and connected to Work Hub/Evidence/Gates. Browser QA proves the interactions and responsive behavior across 1440/1024/390 widths.

verification.summary: desktop/tablet/mobile workload select, Mail handoff, Evidence route, Gates route, no console errors, no horizontal overflow

local_only_boundary: No workflow execution, mail send, community publish, backend write, deploy, DNS, billing, IAM, or cloud provider mutation is wired; all workload-plane actions are browser visual state.
